character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A full-body depiction of a woman herbalist with greying hair tied back, wearing layered leafy green robes with textured fabric folds and a leather satchel slung across her chest. She stands in a calm, grounded pose, clutching a gnarled wooden staff adorned with small, bundled dried herbs and a single glowing crystal at the top. The side-view profile highlights the intricate embroidery on her sleeves and the natural drape of her heavy tunic over sturdy travel boots.
